sections.title: Operational answer
paragraphs: Can an intermediate practitioner safely use a corrected Anthropic evaluation error-triage procedure from the supplied evidence? No. The existing guide body, its prior external citation, the replacement source, and the provider-supported failure states are UNKNOWN, so provider-specific diagnostic and remediation instructions are omitted rather than guessed.

sections.title: Correction scope and remediation
paragraphs: The citation record that triggered this review is content/resources/provider-workflows/anthropic-evaluation-error-triage.json. It is a repository-relative path, not an external HTTPS source. The title and old URL of the source that moved or exceeded its review cadence are UNKNOWN. Consequently, where that source moved and which existing claims or procedures it affects are also UNKNOWN.

First, compare the exact committed resource with its review record to identify the old external citation and every passage that depends on it. If the committed resource or review record cannot be obtained, stop and request those records because a correction-only diff cannot otherwise be established.

Next, open the old citation and the proposed first-party replacement over HTTPS, confirm the publication authority, and compare the material relevant to the guide. If either address does not resolve directly, the authority cannot be confirmed, or the relevant content cannot be compared, do not assign a verification date or revise the dependent passages. Record the failed check and request a resolvable first-party source.

Finally, change only the citation and the passages demonstrably affected by the source comparison. Preserve all other metadata, sections, procedures, and wording exactly. If the comparison does not establish which passages changed, do not publish the correction and escalate it for editorial review.

sections.title: Expected evidence and verification
paragraphs: A complete correction requires the original committed JSON, the prior external source title and URL, a directly resolving first-party replacement URL, evidence of publication authority, a comparison showing what changed, and a correction-only diff. If any item is absent, the correction is not verified and must remain unpublished.

Verify the result by parsing the final file as one JSON object, confirming that its identifier matches the target filename, and checking that it retains exactly three sections and all required resource fields. If parsing or schema validation fails, correct only the invalid structure and repeat both checks.

Then compare the final file with the committed predecessor. The diff should contain only the moved or renewed source record, the passages affected by that source change, and the corresponding verification dates. If unrelated content or metadata changed, restore it and repeat the comparison.

No corrected Anthropic procedure or replacement citation was verified from the supplied evidence on 2026-09-12. Successful verification therefore remains UNKNOWN until the missing records and a resolvable first-party source are checked.
